turns.question: What did we sell in total during the first half of 2025?
turns.resolved: What were Volume Perf's total sales from January 1 through June 30, 2025?
turns.sql:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_sales
FROM sales_orders so
WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
  AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01'

turns.question: Which customer generated the most sales last year?
turns.resolved: Which customer generated the most sales from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31?
turns.sql:
SELECT
  c.customer_code AS customer_code,
  c.name AS customer_name,
  ROUND(SUM(so.total_amount), 2) AS total_sales
FROM sales_orders so
JOIN sales_customers c ON c.id = so.customer_id
WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
  AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND so.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_code, c.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 1

turns.question: Number of orders per quarter in 2024
turns.resolved: Show the number of orders per quarter from January 1 through December 31, 2024, for Volume Perf.
turns.sql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('quarter', so.order_date)::date AS quarter,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM sales_orders so
WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
  AND so.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND so.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', so.order_date)::date
ORDER BY quarter

turns.question: What's the largest single sales order we've ever received?
turns.resolved: Find the largest single sales order Volume Perf has ever received, including its order identifier and value.
turns.sql:
SELECT
    so.order_number AS sales_order,
    ROUND(so.total_amount, 2) AS sales_order_value
FROM sales_orders so
WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
ORDER BY so.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 1

turns.question: How much has Fabrikam ordered from us?
turns.resolved: How much has Fabrikam ordered from Acme in total, across all time?
turns.sql:
SELECT c.name AS customer_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_ordered
FROM sales_orders so
JOIN sales_customers c ON c.id = so.customer_id
WHERE c.name ILIKE '%fabrikam%'
  AND so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_ordered DESC

turns.question: How many sales orders were delivered on or before the requested date?
turns.resolved: For Acme, how many sales orders were delivered on or before their requested date? Count each sales order once.
turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) AS sales_orders_delivered_on_or_before_requested_date
FROM sales_orders so
JOIN sales_deliveries sd ON sd.sales_order_id = so.id
WHERE sd.status = 'POSTED'
  AND sd.delivery_date <= so.requested_date

turns.question: Show monthly revenue for the first quarter of 2026
turns.resolved: Show monthly revenue for Volume Perf from January 1 through March 31, 2026.
turns.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', jl.posting_date)::date AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount), 2) AS revenue
FROM fin_journal_lines jl
JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
WHERE jl.is_posted
  AND a.account_type = 'REVENUE'
  AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', jl.posting_date)::date
ORDER BY month ASC

turns.question: What's the balance of accounts receivable in the ledger?
turns.resolved: What is the balance of accounts receivable in the general ledger for Volume Perf as of 2026-09-27?
turns.sql:
SELECT 'Accounts receivable' AS account,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_debit_amount - jl.functional_credit_amount), 0), 2) AS balance
FROM fin_journal_lines jl
JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
WHERE jl.is_posted
  AND jl.posting_date <= DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND a.account_type = 'ASSET'
  AND a.name ILIKE '%receivable%'

turns.question: How much did we spend on salaries?
turns.resolved: How much did Acme spend on salaries across all available history?
turns.sql:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(hpr.total_gross), 0), 2) AS salary_spend
FROM hr_payroll_runs hpr
WHERE hpr.status = 'POSTED'

turns.question: What is our gross profit?
turns.resolved: What is our gross profit across all available history?
turns.sql:
SELECT ROUND(
         COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount)
           FILTER (WHERE a.account_type = 'REVENUE'), 0)
         - COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_debit_amount - jl.functional_credit_amount)
           FILTER (WHERE a.id IN (SELECT iic.cogs_account_id FROM inv_item_categories iic)), 0),
         2
       ) AS gross_profit
FROM fin_journal_lines jl
JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
WHERE jl.is_posted

turns.question: Which customer has the largest unpaid balance?
turns.resolved: For Acme, which customer has the largest unpaid balance as of 2026-09-27?
turns.sql:
SELECT ci.partner_name AS customer,
       ROUND(SUM(ci.open_amount), 2) AS unpaid_balance
FROM fin_customer_invoices ci
WHERE ci.status IN ('POSTED', 'PARTIALLY_PAID')
  AND ci.open_amount > 0
GROUP BY ci.partner_id, ci.partner_name
ORDER BY unpaid_balance DESC
LIMIT 1

turns.question: How much money did we collect from customers in July 2026?
turns.resolved: How much money did Acme collect from customers from July 1 through July 31, 2026?
turns.sql:

WHERE r.status = 'POSTED'
  AND r.receipt_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND r.receipt_date < DATE '2026-08-01'

turns.question: How many invoices are more than 90 days past due?
turns.resolved: How many customer invoices for Acme had an outstanding balance and were more than 90 days past due as of 2026-09-27 (due before 2026-06-29)?
turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ci.id) AS outstanding_invoices_over_90_days_past_due
FROM fin_customer_invoices ci
WHERE ci.status IN ('POSTED', 'PARTIALLY_PAID')
  AND ci.open_amount > 0
  AND ci.due_date < DATE '2026-06-29'
  AND ci.invoice_number LIKE 'INV-%'

turns.question: Total invoiced amount by customer
turns.resolved: What is the total invoiced amount by customer across all available records?
turns.sql:
SELECT c.name AS customer,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ci.invoice_number LIKE 'CN-%' THEN -ci.net_amount ELSE ci.net_amount END), 2) AS total_invoiced_amount
FROM fin_customer_invoices ci
JOIN sales_customers c ON c.id = ci.partner_id
WHERE ci.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'REVERSED')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_invoiced_amount DESC

turns.question: Which supplier have we bought the most from?
turns.resolved: Which supplier have we bought the most from across all available history, measured by total purchase order value, and what is that value?
turns.sql:
SELECT
    v.name AS supplier_name,
    ROUND(SUM(po.total_amount), 2) AS total_purchase_order_value
FROM proc_purchase_orders po
JOIN proc_vendors v ON v.id = po.vendor_id
WHERE po.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_APPROVAL', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')

ORDER BY total_purchase_order_value DESC
LIMIT 1

turns.question: How many purchase orders does each vendor have?
turns.resolved: How many purchase orders does each vendor have across all time?
turns.sql:
SELECT v.name AS vendor, COUNT(po.id) AS purchase_order_count
FROM proc_purchase_orders po
JOIN proc_vendors v ON v.id = po.vendor_id
GROUP BY v.id, v.name
ORDER BY v.name

turns.question: How many Steel Bolts do we have in stock?

turns.question: What's the value of inventory in each warehouse?

turns.question: What's the total order value for each of them?
turns.resolved: For Acme, show the total order value across all time for each of these customers: Contoso Retail (C-CONTOSO), Fabrikam Inc (C-FABRIKAM), and Northwind Traders (C-NORTH).
turns.sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT so.customer_id,
           ROUND(SUM(so.total_amount), 2) AS total_order_value
    FROM sales_orders so
    WHERE so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CREDIT_BLOCKED')
    GROUP BY so.customer_id
)
SELECT sc.customer_code,
       sc.name AS customer_name,
       COALESCE(ot.total_order_value, 0) AS total_order_value
FROM sales_customers sc
LEFT JOIN order_totals ot ON ot.customer_id = sc.id
WHERE sc.customer_code IN ('C-CONTOSO', 'C-FABRIKAM', 'C-NORTH')
ORDER BY sc.name

turns.question: And how much does each still owe?
turns.resolved: For Acme, show how much each of these customers still owes as of 2026-09-27: Contoso Retail (C-CONTOSO), Fabrikam Inc (C-FABRIKAM), and Northwind Traders (C-NORTH).
turns.sql:
WITH outstanding_by_customer AS (
    SELECT ci.partner_id,
           SUM(ci.open_amount) AS outstanding_amount
    FROM fin_customer_invoices ci
    WHERE ci.status IN ('POSTED', 'PARTIALLY_PAID')
      AND ci.open_amount > 0
    GROUP BY ci.partner_id
)
SELECT sc.customer_code,
       sc.name AS customer_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(obc.outstanding_amount, 0), 2) AS outstanding_amount
FROM sales_customers sc
LEFT JOIN outstanding_by_customer obc ON obc.partner_id = sc.id
WHERE sc.customer_code IN ('C-CONTOSO', 'C-FABRIKAM', 'C-NORTH')
ORDER BY sc.name

turns.question: Who has paid us anything so far?
turns.resolved: For Acme, which of Contoso Retail (C-CONTOSO), Fabrikam Inc (C-FABRIKAM), and Northwind Traders (C-NORTH) have paid us anything from all time through 2026-09-27?
turns.sql:
SELECT sc.customer_code,
       sc.name AS customer_name,
       ROUND(SUM(cr.amount), 2) AS total_paid
FROM sales_customers sc
JOIN fin_customer_receipts cr ON cr.partner_id = sc.id
WHERE sc.customer_code IN ('C-CONTOSO', 'C-FABRIKAM', 'C-NORTH')
  AND cr.status = 'POSTED'
  AND cr.receipt_date <= DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY sc.id, sc.customer_code, sc.name
HAVING SUM(cr.amount) > 0
ORDER BY sc.name

turns.question: What was our revenue in 2025?
turns.resolved: What was Volume Perf's revenue from January 1, 2025 through December 31, 2025?
turns.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount), 2) AS revenue
FROM fin_journal_lines jl
JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
WHERE jl.is_posted
  AND a.account_type = 'REVENUE'
  AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

turns.question: And the cost of goods sold?
turns.resolved: What was Volume Perf's cost of goods sold from January 1, 2025 through December 31, 2025?
turns.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(jl.functional_debit_amount - jl.functional_credit_amount), 2) AS cost_of_goods_sold
FROM fin_journal_lines jl
JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
WHERE jl.is_posted
  AND a.id IN (SELECT ic.cogs_account_id FROM inv_item_categories ic)
  AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

turns.question: So what's the gross profit?
turns.resolved: What was Volume Perf's gross profit, calculated as revenue minus cost of goods sold, from January 1, 2025 through December 31, 2025?
turns.sql:
SELECT ROUND(
         COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount)
                  FILTER (WHERE a.account_type = 'REVENUE'), 0)
         - COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_debit_amount - jl.functional_credit_amount)
                    FILTER (WHERE a.id IN (
                      SELECT ic.cogs_account_id
                      FROM inv_item_categories ic
                    )), 0),
         2
       ) AS gross_profit
FROM fin_journal_lines jl
JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
WHERE jl.is_posted
  AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

turns.question: How does that compare with 2024?
turns.resolved: Compare Volume Perf's gross profit, calculated as revenue minus cost of goods sold, for January 1 through December 31, 2025 with January 1 through December 31, 2024, showing both periods side by side.
turns.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount)
             FILTER (WHERE a.account_type = 'REVENUE'
                       AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
                       AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2025-01-01'), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_debit_amount - jl.functional_credit_amount)
               FILTER (WHERE a.id IN (
                 SELECT ic.cogs_account_id
                 FROM inv_item_categories ic
               )
                 AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
                 AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2025-01-01'), 0),
    2
  ) AS gross_profit_2024,
  ROUND(
    COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_credit_amount - jl.functional_debit_amount)
             FILTER (WHERE a.account_type = 'REVENUE'
                       AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                       AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-01-01'), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(jl.functional_debit_amount - jl.functional_credit_amount)
               FILTER (WHERE a.id IN (
                 SELECT ic.cogs_account_id
                 FROM inv_item_categories ic
               )
                 AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
                 AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-01-01'), 0),
    2
  ) AS gross_profit_2025
FROM fin_journal_lines jl
JOIN fin_accounts a ON a.id = jl.account_id
WHERE jl.is_posted
  AND jl.posting_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND jl.posting_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

turns.question: Which items did we purchase?
turns.resolved: Which items did Acme purchase across all available history?
turns.sql:
SELECT i.item_code,
       i.name AS item_name,
       SUM(pol.quantity) AS quantity_purchased,
       ROUND(SUM(pol.line_amount), 2) AS purchase_amount
FROM proc_purchase_order_lines pol
JOIN proc_purchase_orders po ON po.id = pol.po_id
JOIN inv_items i ON i.id = pol.item_id
WHERE po.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_APPROVAL', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')
GROUP BY i.id, i.item_code, i.name
ORDER BY i.item_code

turns.question: How much did we spend on each?
turns.resolved: How much did Acme spend on each item across all available history: Steel Bolt M6 (ITM-BOLT) and Plastic Casing (ITM-CASING)?
turns.sql:
SELECT i.item_code,
       i.name AS item_name,
       ROUND(SUM(pol.line_amount), 2) AS purchase_amount
FROM proc_purchase_order_lines pol
JOIN proc_purchase_orders po ON po.id = pol.po_id
JOIN inv_items i ON i.id = pol.item_id
WHERE po.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_APPROVAL', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')
  AND i.item_code IN ('ITM-BOLT', 'ITM-CASING')
GROUP BY i.id, i.item_code, i.name
ORDER BY i.item_code

turns.question: Which vendor supplied the most expensive one?
turns.resolved: Which vendor supplied the most expensive item, Plastic Casing (ITM-CASING), based on purchase spend across all available history?
turns.sql:
SELECT v.vendor_code,
       v.name AS vendor_name,
       ROUND(SUM(pol.line_amount), 2) AS purchase_spend
FROM proc_purchase_order_lines pol
JOIN proc_purchase_orders po ON po.id = pol.po_id
JOIN inv_items i ON i.id = pol.item_id
JOIN proc_vendors v ON v.id = po.vendor_id
WHERE po.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_APPROVAL', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')
  AND i.item_code = 'ITM-CASING'
GROUP BY v.id, v.vendor_code, v.name
ORDER BY purchase_spend DESC
LIMIT 1
